difficultyRationale: Checks superclass-constructor invocation order during object construction.
explanation: A subclass constructor invokes a superclass constructor before executing its own body. Therefore constructing `B` prints `A` first and `B` second.

options.explanation: The superclass constructor runs before the subclass constructor body.
The subclass body does not run before superclass construction.
The superclass constructor is still invoked.

options.text: It does not compile because B does not explicitly call super().
options.explanation: The compiler inserts an implicit no-argument super() call when permitted.
